answers.justification: Compliance document explicitly states chpl: true and that 'SIM-X1 is treated as dual-use and on the simulated CHPL.' The group has current (Cuba, Lebanon) and planned (Myanmar) activity involving SIM-X1 instruments on the CHPL.

answers.section: Section D: Trade Restrictive Measures/Trade Sanctions / Sekcja D
answers.label: 2 - szczegóły środków kontroli / details of controls (if Yes)
answers.value: Anti-diversion controls: contracts prohibit re-export to or use in Russia; verified end-user certificates, serial-number tracking, destination checks, no-resale undertakings, shipment holds and post-delivery reviews enforce the prohibition. Screening: customers, beneficial owners, directors, employees, suppliers, end-users, intermediaries and transactions are screened at onboarding, daily and before payment/shipment against scenario versions of Poland, EU, UN, UK and OFAC lists. Compliance investigates alerts; transactions are held pending clearance. Quarterly risk review, annual independent audit (last 2026-06-30), annual staff training, escalation and incident records are maintained.
answers.justification: The compliance document details anti-diversion measures specific to CHPL items (contracts, end-user certificates, serial tracking, destination checks, no-resale, shipment holds, post-delivery reviews) and the broader screening and monitoring policy applied to all controlled entities.

answers.section: Section D: Trade Restrictive Measures/Trade Sanctions / Sekcja D
answers.label: 3. Have you implemented policies and procedures to comply with Polish, EU, UK or US Trade Sanctions?
answers.justification: The compliance document describes a group-wide policy applying to all controlled entities, branches and joint ventures, with screening against Poland, EU, UN, UK and OFAC lists, alert investigation, transaction holds, quarterly risk review, annual audit, annual training, and escalation procedures.

answers.section: Section D: Trade Restrictive Measures/Trade Sanctions / Sekcja D
answers.label: 3 - krótkie podsumowanie polityk/procedur / brief overview of policies and controls (if Yes)
answers.value: Group policy applies to all controlled entities, branches and joint ventures. Customers, beneficial owners, directors, employees, suppliers, end-users, intermediaries and transactions are screened at onboarding, daily and before payment/shipment against scenario versions of Poland, EU, UN, UK and OFAC lists. Compliance investigates alerts; transactions are held pending clearance. Quarterly risk review, annual independent audit (last 2026-06-30), annual staff training, escalation and incident records are maintained. Anti-diversion controls for dual-use/CHPL items include: contracts prohibiting re-export to or use in Russia, verified end-user certificates, serial-number tracking, destination checks, no-resale undertakings, shipment holds and post-delivery reviews.
answers.justification: Brief overview drawn from the compliance policy field and the anti-diversion controls described in the dual-use section of the compliance document.
